newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet edges up on futures but premiums stagnate.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet edges up on futures but premiums stagnate.

text.p: NWE jet fuel rose on Thursday in line with benchmark IPE gas oil futures gains but premiums were little changed, traders said.
Benchmark IPE gas oil closed $1.50 higher at $161.75 a tonne.
Jet fuel oil barge premiums stagnated around the July IPE +$15.00/$16.00 fob ARA level in a very dull market.
"There are bits and bobs getting done but nothing to write home about and most of it is p'n'c," said one trader.
Heating oil cargo premiums were assessed around the July IPE +$17/+$18 level.
